info.title: ACCESS Events API
info.description:
The ACCESS Events API provides access to upcoming and past events, trainings, webinars, and office hours.

## Features
- **Pagination**: Default 100 items per page, customizable with `items_per_page` parameter
- **Faceted Search**: Filter by event type, affiliation, skill level, tags, and date ranges
- **CORS Enabled**: Can be called from any domain
- **Date Filtering**: Support for both relative (`today`, `+1week`) and absolute date formats
- **Timezone Support**: UTC (default), America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London

## Authentication
No authentication required - this is a public API.

get.description: Retrieve a list of events with optional filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: items_per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (25, 50, 100, 250, 500, or "All")

parameters.name: f[0]
parameters.description: Faceted search filter in format `field:value`. Examples: `custom_event_type:Training`, `custom_event_affiliation:Community`
